I came from an old Mac years ago and wanted the same mouse acceleration. I was able to customize it with xinput

mouse='Microsoft Basic Optical Mouse'
xinput --set-prop "$mouse" "Device Accel Adaptive Deceleration" 2
xinput --set-prop "$mouse" "Device Accel Constant Deceleration" 2.6
xinput set-ptr-feedback "$mouse" 0 25 10
xinput --set-prop "$mouse" "Device Accel Profile" 2

(see lsusb for name of your mouse to use). I admit that I had to find the source code for this mouse acceleration, cut it out and write a program that graphed its acceleration characteristics, along with the old Mac's, and fiddle with the values until the curves were a near match.
